modos.descricao: Todos personagens e aliados espiritos +2 Gnosis ate fim do turno + comprar 1 carta sept

_metadata.texto_original: Your pack must have a Caern in order to use this Rite. You call upon the Caern's totem to bless your pack. All your Characters and Spirit Allies are +2 Gnosis until the end of the turn. Draw a Sept card during the next Umbra phase.
